answer: Vesting-gated rewards: an identity's payouts pass through one inlet that sends 90% into a locked jade vault unlocking linearly over 30 epochs; 10% is spendable. Step 1, each epoch the randomness beacon picks 5 graders to re-score a random past answer. Step 2, a failed re-score burns the whole unvested vault. Step 3, only 30 clean epochs make it liquid. A farm of 1,000 fakes earning 50 POA/epoch keeps ~675,000 POA hostage, so one exposed template costs far more than it farmed. Weakness: patient fakes writing real answers; mitigation: each then costs as much work as an honest agent.
